title: Your direction: a grainy gradient and Carnet's own icons
question: As you said: a light grainy gradient behind everything (matcha, lilac and peach with a fine grain), small improvements (the search strip, chips and bottom bar turn translucent so the gradient runs under them; the capture pebble takes the same grain and light), and an original icon set. The gradient and improvements are the same on every card; only the icons change. Each card: the board, the drawer, and the set itself. Pick a set, or steer (stronger or fainter gradient, other colours…).

options.label: Découpé
options.lineage: The collection emblems: shapes cut from paper with scissors
options.thesis: Solid icons cut from paper like the emblems: straight cuts a little off true, details cut out as holes, so the whole interface speaks the emblems' language.
materials: pebbles as the bell's clapper and the settings knobs
options.viewport: Board on the grainy gradient, translucent search and bar, solid cut-paper icons; the drawer in the same ground and icons.
options.risk: Heavy at small sizes and close to any filled set unless the cuts stay visible; selected icons can no longer switch from line to fill.
options.case: One language for icons and emblems: everything is cut paper.

options.label: Galet
options.lineage: The brand's pebble, set into a clean line icon wherever a dot belongs
options.thesis: Clean round-ended lines with one signature: the pebble of the mark is the bell's clapper, the sun of a photo, the knobs of the settings, the three dots of More, the bullets of a list.
materials: the mark's pebble as every dot
options.viewport: Board on the grainy gradient, translucent search and bar, line icons with their little pebbles; the drawer in the same ground and icons.
options.risk: The quietest of the three: at a glance it reads as a well-made line set, the pebbles reward a second look.
options.case: Original without shouting, legible at every size, and tied to the mark.

options.label: Croquis
options.lineage: An architect's sketch in a carnet: one fine pen, lines running past their corners
options.thesis: Icons drawn like a quick architectural sketch: straight lines that cross at the corners, loops that overlap where they close, one fine pen for everything.
options.viewport: Board on the grainy gradient, translucent search and bar, sketched line icons and sketched checkboxes; the drawer in the same ground and icons.
options.risk: Can read unfinished: at 24px a crossing corner can look like a slip of the pen, and checkboxes become little frames.
options.case: The most personal: the app looks drawn in its own carnet.
